title: A Finch on Two Tiny Islands Drinks Other Birds' Blood

scenes.text: There's a bird that drinks the blood of other birds.
It's the vampire ground finch, and it lives on just two tiny Galapagos islands.
It pierces a big seabird's wing or tail with its sharp beak, then drinks the blood.
In the dry season, other food runs out, so blood becomes a backup meal.
Scientists found its gut bacteria are more like a vampire bat's than like other finches'.
So yes: a bird that lives like a vampire.

description:
The vampire ground finch drinks the blood of larger seabirds on two Galapagos islands.
Its gut bacteria look more like a vampire bat's than like other finches'.
What's the weirdest bird you know?
